prOriginal.nota: Found with gh pr list search 'Encoding context to access token IDs'; headRefOid equals benchmark head daffb05b (2 commits), squash-merged as c8738721. Per-file additions/deletions of the squash commit match base..head exactly.

implement-access-token-context-encoding-.reason: AccessTokenContext constructor on main still has `Objects.requireNonNull(grantType, "Null rawTokenId not allowed")` as the fourth check; rawTokenId is still never null-checked. Later edits (#37701, user session lookup changes) did not touch this line.

AssertEvents.isAccessTokenId was moved by #48752 (2026-05-20) into EventMatchers.isAccessTokenId (test-framework/core and testsuite copies), with identical logic: items[0].substring(3, 5).equals(expectedGrantShortcut) returns false, then only the token-id suffix is checked. The inverted/misaligned grant check is still there.

DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderTest on main still builds the factory with init(null) and hand-filled maps without postInit (sessionFactory null), and testIncorrectGrantType still catches RuntimeException for 'ofrtac:5678', so an NPE still satisfies it.

Partially fixed: #37701 (2025-02-27, https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/pull/37701) added clientSessionCtx.setAttribute(Constants.GRANT_TYPE, ...) to ClientCredentialsGrantType, so client-credentials ids now carry 'cc'. The UMA path in AuthorizationTokenService still creates its own clientSessionCtx and calls generateAccessToken() with no GRANT_TYPE, and DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider still falls back to 'na', so part of the reported behaviour remains.

astra.pergunta: Client-credentials case got GRANT_TYPE set in #37701 one day after merge; UMA path in AuthorizationTokenService still never sets it. Which single status fits?
astra.resposta: #37701 fixed only the client-credentials part; the UMA path still lacks GRANT_TYPE and falls back to 'na'. Since the TP explicitly covers both flows, the status should reflect the remaining defect; client credentials alone would be confirmado.

implement-access-token-context-encoding-.reason: DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory has no commits after the merge; getShortcutByGrantType/getGrantTypeByShortcut still lazily put into both maps without the duplicate-shortcut check done in postInit.

OAuth2GrantTypeFactory on main still declares `String getShortcut();` with no default (no commits to the file since merge), and postInit still calls gtf.getShortcut() on every registered grant factory.
